models.name: Logistic Regression
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Support Vector Machine (RBF)
models.notes: Probabilities from Platt (sigmoid) scaling via CalibratedClassifierCV(ensemble=False).
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Random Forest
models.notes: Tree ensemble; scale-invariant, so no scaler.
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Decision Tree
models.notes: Single CART tree; probabilities are leaf frequencies (coarse).
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: K-Nearest Neighbors
models.notes: Distance-based; requires scaling. Probabilities are neighbour vote fractions.
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Gaussian Naive Bayes
models.notes: Assumes conditional feature independence — strongly violated here (radius/perimeter/area are near-collinear), so probabilities tend to be extreme.
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Gradient Boosting (optional)
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

notes.cv: Mean ± SD over outer folds of nested CV on the training split (threshold 0.5). Used for model selection.
notes.test: Single evaluation on the untouched 20% hold-out split after selection. Reported for every model for transparency; not used for selection.
